body:
## Summary

- detect Git-backed workspace roots and snapshot them as synthetic commits
- fetch the advertised upstream base on the engine, then use native Git negotiation against a client-hosted `upload-pack` to transfer only missing tracked, ignored, and untracked contents
- retain the thin-bundle RPC as compatibility fallback and traditional filesync for non-Git roots, filtered reads, unsupported clients, and unusable remotes
- cache unchanged workspace snapshots and add a development-only Cloud image override plus a topology-aware benchmark and demo

This is an exploratory draft intended to make the implementation and benchmark results easy to discuss before further optimization.

## Benchmark

The matched fixture uses a real `dagger/dagger` checkout at `origin/main`, replaces 64 tracked files with deterministic 256 KiB payloads, and adds 128 untracked 128 KiB files: a 33.6 MB local delta over a repository whose `.git` directory is roughly 450 MB.

Both Cloud engines are prewarmed with a trivial unmeasured query so image provisioning is excluded. The current upload-pack prototype produced:

| Topology | Arm | Cold | Warm unchanged |
| --- | --- | ---: | ---: |
| Local Docker | filesync | 9.158 s | 1.684 s |
| Local Docker | client Git server | 37.261 s | 1.876 s |
| Dagger Cloud | filesync | >300 s | not run after timeout |
| Dagger Cloud | client Git server | 14.897 s | 5.026 s |

The preceding thin-bundle prototype measured 45.074 s / 1.792 s locally and 15.087 s / 4.494 s on Cloud. Native upload-pack is somewhat better on the local cold path, but effectively equivalent to the bundle on Cloud. The large remote win comes from avoiding filesync of `.git`, not from choosing bundle versus upload-pack for the delta.

Raw matched results are retained in `/tmp/workspace-snapshot-upload-pack-local` and `/tmp/workspace-snapshot-upload-pack-cloud` on the benchmark host. Benchmark and demo instructions live under `hack/bench/workspace-snapshot/`.

## Tests

- `go test ./engine/session/git ./engine/engineutil ./core ./core/schema -count=1`
- `go test ./internal/cloud -count=1`
- `dagger call engine-dev test --pkg=./core/integration --run="^TestWorkspace/TestWorkspaceWorktreePlainParity$"`
- matched local and Cloud filesync-versus-upload-pack benchmark
